full_text: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
explanation: Historical provision applicable for theft offenses committed before 1 July 2024.
essential_ingredients: Dishonest taking of movable property out of possession without consent
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

section_title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
full_text: Whoever drives any vehicle, or rides, on any public way in a manner so rash or negligent as to endanger human life, or to be likely to cause hurt or injury to any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
explanation: Historical provision for rash driving offences committed prior to 1 July 2024.
essential_ingredients: Driving in a rash or negligent manner on a public way
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 6 months or fine up to Rs. 1,000 or both.

full_text: Whoever causes the death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
explanation: Historical provision for vehicular or operational death caused by negligence before 1 July 2024.
essential_ingredients: Death caused by rash or negligent act without intent of homicide
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.
